does: Scores for the AI the destruction of an item, including the surface its destruction would leave.

evidence.says: calls IsItemInteresting, eoc::SurfaceShapes::SimpleFlood and CalculateAiScoreSurface for the item's destruction surface
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 1 place, CalculateAiScoreDamageItem
